newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia sends aid to Iran quake victims.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia sends aid to Iran quake victims.

text.p: Tunisia on Thursday sent a cargo plane-load of emergency aid to the earthquake victims in Iran, officials said.
The aid includes medicines, food and blankets, they added.

Nearly 1,000 people were killed and 2,600 injured in last Friday's quake, which disrupted the lives of 60,000 people in northwest Iran. It was followed by 500 aftershocks and another quake measuring 5.2 on Sunday night.

The official Iranian news agency IRNA said aid from Turkey, Oman, Tunisia, Jordan, Japan, Germany, Azerbaijan and Saudi Arabia had either been sent or was on its way. Iran on Tuesday issued an international appeal for help through the United Nations.
